name: Wyandotte
seo_title: Wyandotte Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Wyandotte, Michigan for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Wyandotte's Christmas for kids centers on Santa at the library, a free church party and a Friday evening at the museum.
celebrates: Wyandotte's 2026 kids' Christmas events come from the library, a church and the city's museums. Bacon Memorial District Library welcomes Santa on Saturday, December 5. St. Stephen's Episcopal Church hosts a free family Christmas party with nativity animals on Sunday, December 13, and the Wyandotte Museums open for Festive Fridays on December 18. The city's Christmas parade and tree lighting took place earlier, on November 21, so this page covers what is still ahead.
lastyear: A downriver tourism and local news round-up lists Wyandotte's 83rd Christmas Parade on Saturday, November 21, 2026, and the city's tree lighting before it. For past years, a 2018 News Herald article described the Ford-MacNichol Home at 2610 Biddle Avenue as open on Fridays in December, so the museum evenings are a long-standing tradition.
facts: The Ford-MacNichol Home at 2610 Biddle Avenue is part of the Wyandotte Museums and hosts Victorian Christmas tours in December, according to local listings. Bacon Memorial District Library, at 45 Vinewood, is under renovation and has one entrance off Vinewood. St. Stephen's is at 2803 First Street. Wyandotte's Midnight Madness shopping night is on December 18, according to the city's shop-local group.
trains: Wyandotte has no Christmas train event on this page. For heritage rail, The Henry Ford's Greenfield Village in Dearborn has a railroad with an 1884 roundhouse, and the Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens is a volunteer-run museum in an 1859 Grand Trunk depot. In Flat Rock, the Model Train Depot shows Christmas displays on four December Saturdays, which appear on our Brownstown page.

faq: Where can kids see Santa in Wyandotte?

Bacon Memorial District Library lists Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 am to 12:30 pm and 1 to 4 pm. St. Stephen's Episcopal Church also has Santa at its free family Christmas party on December 13 from noon to 1 pm.
Is there a free Christmas event in Wyandotte?
Yes. The church's own post calls its family party free, with Santa, nativity animals, crafts, cookies and hot cocoa on December 13 at 2803 First Street.
When is Festive Fridays at the Wyandotte Museum?
The city calendar lists December 18, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at 2610 Biddle Avenue.
When was the Wyandotte Christmas parade?
A Downriver tourism guide lists the 83rd Christmas Parade on Saturday, November 21, 2026, so it has already passed.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
